'''Cyrina Fiallo''' (born December 29, 1991) is an American actress and filmmaker.

==Early life and career==
Cyrina Fiallo was born in [[Miami, Florida]], and is of [[Cubans|Cuban]] and [[Italians|Italian]] descent.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/cyrinafiallo/status/446794519678173185 |title=Twitter / cyrinafiallo: @KieeranHill Cuban/Italian! |publisher=Twitter.com |date= |accessdate=2014-03-21}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Phil Lord And Chris Miller Are Heading To Miami To Produce A Cuban-American Family Comedy From Natalie Morales |url=https://www.slashfilm.com/576283/phil-lord-and-chris-miller-producing-miami-comedy-natalie-morales/ |website=www.slashfilm.com}}</ref>
Fiallo is best known for her recurring role as Vonnie on the [[Disney Channel]] sitcom ''[[Good Luck Charlie]]''. She also has guest starred on ''[[Everybody Hates Chris]]'', ''[[Community (TV series)|Community]]'', ''[[Gigantic (TV series)|Gigantic]]'', ''[[Glee (TV series)|Glee]]'', ''[[Switched at Birth (TV series)|Switched at Birth]]'', ''[[Girl Meets World]]''  and ''[[Supernatural (American TV series)|Supernatural]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.winchesterbros.com/site/index.php/interviews/9334-interview-with-a-witch-our-exclusive-interview-with-cyrina-fiallo-supernaturals-delta-mendota |title=Interview with a Witch! Our exclusive interview with Cyrina Fiallo, Supernatural's Delta Mendota |publisher=Winchesterbros.com |date=2012-11-18 |accessdate=2012-12-31 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130824141324/http://www.winchesterbros.com/site/index.php/interviews/9334-interview-with-a-witch-our-exclusive-interview-with-cyrina-fiallo-supernaturals-delta-mendota |archivedate=2013-08-24 }}</ref> She also starred in the internet television series ''[[My Alibi]]'' and ''The Subpranos'', the latter of which she co-wrote, co-directed and co-produced with fellow actress [[Chrissie Fit]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.thesubpranos.com/thesubpranos/welcome.html |title=''The Subpranos'' |access-date=2012-12-31 |archive-date=2012-09-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120905170744/http://thesubpranos.com/thesubpranos/welcome.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

She is also a member of the [[cover band|cover group]] The Girls, alongside fellow actresses [[Alison Brie]] and [[Julianna Guill]].<ref>{{cite news|author=Crystal Bell |url=https://www.huffpost.com/entry/alison-brie-band-the-girls-community_n_1414468 |title=Alison Brie Band, The Girls: 'Community' Star Makes Music With Julianna Guill And Cyrina Fiallo (VIDEO) |publisher=HuffPost |date= 2012-04-10|accessdate=2012-12-31}}</ref>

Fiallo has appeared in numerous TV commercials for various retailers, such as [[Verizon]], [[Allstate]], [[Booking.com]], [[Capital One]], [[Pepsi]], [[Samsung]], and [[Subaru]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Verizon commercials actors: Kate McKinnon, Cyrina Fiallo and more.|url=https://www.tuko.co.ke/facts-lifehacks/tv-movies/432856-verizon-commercials-actors-actresses-profiles-roles/ |website=www.tuko.co.ke}}</ref><ref>[https://www.ispot.tv/topic/actor-actress/uS/cyrina-fiallo Cyrina Fiallo TV Spots]. iSpot.TV.</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Who is the actress in the verizon commercial |url=https://theconservativenut.com/who-is-the-actress-in-the-verizon-commercial/#Who_is_the_Actress_in_the_Verizon_Commercial |website=heconservativenut.com}}</ref>

In October 2022, Fiallo provided the narration for the audiobook of the novel entitled, ''Witchlings'' by Claribel A. Ortega.<ref>{{cite web |title=Witchlings by Claribel A. Ortega, Read by Cyrina Fiallo |url=https://lithub.com/witchlings-by-claribel-a-ortega-read-by-cyrina-fiallo/ |website=lithub.com}}</ref>
